release: Agent-Crypto @erith.IA · Build 39.2.9 · ADMINISTRATOR MIRROR · HOVER CHROME LOCK

engine.name: Market Core V2.0-Alpha
engine.status: business behavior preserved; global application version is 39.2.9

notes: 39.2.9 is a visual-only hover-chrome polish on the functionally validated 39.2.8 window model.
Administrator controls keep the same positions, hit targets and actions, but recede at rest and reveal when the pointer enters their operational window; direct control hover gives full contrast.
Target Top, Market Flow and Market Snapshot receive the strongest at-rest attenuation so the live data remains visually dominant without making the controls unavailable.
Reduced restore bars keep their title readable while their chrome is quieter at rest and reveals on hover; + Restaurer and × behavior is unchanged.
Atlas Math Core retains the 39.2.8 contract: Classic docked behavior, medium right-side detached window, native Dessus/Latéral/Réduire controls and explicit maximize.
No market, chart, Atlas, NØX, Aerith, Memory, Bridge, Ollama, WebSocket, timer or business-state behavior is changed by this build.
